_comment: Data for tools/build-archive.py. 'outlets' maps a URL domain (without www.) to the outlet credit shown in the archive. Only domains listed here are linked: a story whose Article URL is an aggregator or an unlisted domain is OMITTED and logged, never guessed. Add a domain here only after verifying it is the original publisher. 'url_replacements' maps date -> story number -> a verified original article URL, for stories whose briefing Article URL is an aggregator (e.g. siliconnoon.com) but whose original reporting was found elsewhere. 'headline_overrides' maps date -> story number -> the exact final headline, for the few editorial trims the number/curly-quote rules cannot reproduce.
